patch_list: Adds a "Crypto Alerts" app icon with your own price alerts (a price above or below a target, or a 24h change), checked about every 15 minutes with free public prices (Binance, then CoinGecko) and shown as notifications, plus a chart and a…
Lets the patched app start. Without it the app sees it wasn't installed from the Play Store, shows a paywall and closes. Keep it on.
Hides the banners and the ads between the news, using the app's own ad-free mode for new users, kept on for good. Pro isn't unlocked.
